component.name: OxideSip
component.summary: Native Linux SIP softphone with PipeWire audio

description.p: OxideSip registers one or more SIP accounts with your PBX (FreePBX, Asterisk and others) and gives each of them five call lines. Place, answer, hold, transfer and join calls, send DTMF, record calls, and route call audio into or out of other applications such as Discord — all through native PipeWire streams.

ul.li: Multiple accounts registered at once, five lines each, with hold, blind transfer and local three-way join
Incoming calls open an always-on-top window with Answer and Decline, plus a desktop notification with the same buttons
RFC 4733 DTMF with SIP INFO fallback, ordered codec priority (G.711 µ-law / A-law), optional SDES-SRTP, UDP/TCP/TLS transports
Contacts with JSON import/export, call history with filters, Do Not Disturb, auto-answer and a deny list
Secondary audio routing: send the other party's voice to another app or mix another app's audio into the call
Dark and light themes that follow the desktop, keyboard shortcuts, and a compact floating call bar

screenshot.caption: An active call: lines, meters and call controls

description.p: New sidebar layout, dark and light themes, a rebuilt incoming-call window with desktop notifications, structured caller ID, a real app icon, and a demo/screenshot mode.
